workflow: HTF map first: 60M, 120M, and 240M provide support, obstacle, draw, or caution only.
15M parent setup: a real 15M displacement must create the parent FVG.
Drill to 5M: price must return into the 15M FVG area or a clean nested aligned 5M FVG.
Completed 5M wick defense: completed 5M candle must test and reject the FVG area without accepting through it against the trade.
Entry is the completed 5M wick-defense or confirmation close.
Stop is the nearest protected 5M structure for the active side.
T1 and T2 are calculated from actual entry-to-stop risk.
Balanced price context is not a trigger; it explains whether the path can deliver cleanly to real liquidity before T1.
Opposing FVG before T1 is not an automatic downgrade if liquidity sits between entry and T1, gets reached, and no opposing FVG defends first.

requiredFacts: candidate already passed the clean completed-plan workflow
first real-liquidity objective sits between entry and T1
that liquidity objective is reached during the replay window
no opposing FVG defends before liquidity delivery
balancedPathToLiquidityDefinition.meaning: The trade is delivering through a balanced/rebalanced path to real liquidity, so an opposing FVG before T1 should be managed as context instead of automatically downgrading the valid FVG rejection.

htfMapLesson.rule: HTF FVGs, displacement zones, and older imbalance areas can explain support, resistance, targets, or defended obstacles, but they do not approve a trade by themselves.
htfMapLesson.executionBoundary: The 15M parent FVG plus completed 5M wick-defense/proof remains the research execution workflow.
htfMapLesson.contractRule: Research must use the active chart contract, currently MES 09-26, so chart review and replay prices stay aligned.

ladderOrder: nearest opposing FVG or HTF reaction obstacle before T1
first real liquidity objective between entry and T1
runner liquidity or larger HTF objective after T2
fvgInventoryAndObjectiveLadder.meaning: The model should remember open FVGs above and below price. A clean continuation can run through balanced price toward the next real liquidity target, but an older opposing FVG that defends before delivery can kill or downgrade the trade.
fvgInventoryAndObjectiveLadder.jan7Lesson: The Jan 7 morning long was not a clean continuation because an older opposing FVG defended before T1. The liquidity ladder alone was not enough.
fvgInventoryAndObjectiveLadder.jan13Lesson: The Jan 13 shorts stayed valid because the path to first liquidity was balanced and the opposing FVG context did not defend before liquidity delivery.

balancedMarketContext.rule: Balanced market structure is context, not a trigger.
balancedMarketContext.validUse: If price has already rebalanced the path between entry and the next real liquidity pool, the model can score the trade as a cleaner delivery path when the FVG rejection and 5M proof are valid.
balancedMarketContext.invalidUse: Balanced price alone cannot create a trade, override a failed 15M parent setup, or replace completed 5M wick-defense proof.
balancedMarketContext.targetBehavior: When the first real liquidity objective is closer than T1, mark it as a management objective before the app-style R targets.

protectedStopAnchoring.rule: Stop must anchor to the nearest protected 5M structure for the active side.
protectedStopAnchoring.shortStop: For a short, use the nearest protected 5M swing high or rejection structure above entry that invalidates the short idea.
protectedStopAnchoring.longStop: For a long, use the nearest protected 5M swing low or rejection structure below entry that invalidates the long idea.
protectedStopAnchoring.targetMath: T1 and T2 must be recalculated from the actual entry-to-protected-stop risk.

antiDriftRulesFromReview.parentDisplacementNuance: A valid 15M FVG parent may come from an impulse/displacement candle that is the left, middle, or final confirming candle of the three-candle FVG formation. Do not force only the final FVG-confirming candle to carry the displacement read when the imbalance was clearly created by the impulse leg.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.sameParentCampaignRule: When multiple same-side FVG candidates derive from the same parent displacement, the first valid completed 5M proof is the research trade candidate. Later same-parent rows are management or re-entry context unless a reset rule is explicitly approved.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.failedParentRule: If the 15M parent FVG or aligned nested 5M FVG accepts through against the trade direction before proof, the continuation setup is dead. Later wick-defense-looking candles cannot revive that failed parent.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.sessionWindowRule: Research scripts must use explicit session windows and must report the window used. Hidden morning-only cutoffs such as 12:30, 13:00, or 13:30 must not decide afternoon/lunch research.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.gateTraceRule: Every rejected candidate needs a gate trace naming the exact failed gate before the model definition is changed.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.holidayBridgeContextRule: A Friday after a Thursday federal holiday may be tagged holiday_bridge_thin_participation for research only. It must not block, approve, publish, rank, or alter trades by itself.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.morningLiquidityMemoryRule: Lunch/PM research must preserve same-day morning/RTH liquidity levels and open FVG inventory; the afternoon model cannot forget what the morning created or left behind.
antiDriftRulesFromReview.fiveMinuteStandaloneBoundary: A standalone 5M FVG without a valid 15M parent displacement FVG is a separate research idea or no-trade. It is not the FairValueGapResearchModel.
